description: Technical, procedural or administrative amendment with no clear political dispute (deadlines, definitions, regulator powers, minor procedure)
Benefits for soldiers, reservists and discharged soldiers: tax credits, grants, tuition, daycare, priority in hiring or land, job protection (מילואים, חיילים משוחררים, הטבות)

Harsher measures against terrorists and their families: deportation of families, house demolitions, not returning bodies, minimum sentences for stone throwing, terror offenses, sanctions on terror supporters (מחבלים, גירוש משפחות, הריסת בתים)

Judicial overhaul: Supreme Court powers and panels, judicial selection, override clause, splitting the Attorney General role, legal advisers, Israel Bar, constitutional court (בית המשפט העליון, היועץ המשפטי לממשלה, פסקת התגברות)
Immigration control: asylum seekers and infiltrators, illegal residents, foreign workers, border protection, deportation of migrants (מסתננים, שוהים בלתי חוקיים, עובדים זרים)

Security detainees and prisoners: lawyer access, detention extensions, unlawful combatants, prison conditions, medical care and Red Cross access for security prisoners (עצור בעבירת ביטחון, אסיר ביטחוני, לוחמים בלתי חוקיים)

Structure and rules of government and Knesset: who forms the government, acting PM, ministers' qualifications, Knesset committees, opposition rights, cabinet procedures (חוק-יסוד: הממשלה, הכנסת, ועדות)
Women's representation and gender equality in politics, boards and public bodies; gender budgeting; advancing women (ייצוג נשים, שוויון מגדרי)
Military conscription of Haredi yeshiva students, draft exemptions, sanctions on draft evaders and institutions encouraging evasion, Torah study status (גיוס חרדים, השתמטות, לומדי תורה)

Judea and Samaria (West Bank) measures other than formal sovereignty: land purchase and land registry, young settlements, disengagement law repeal, Civil Administration, heritage authority, terminology (יהודה והשומרון, התנחלויות, ההתנתקות)
Organized crime, illegal weapons, protection racketeering, agricultural crime, looting (נשק בלתי חוקי, ארגוני פשיעה, דמי חסות)
Chief Rabbinate, city rabbis, rabbinical and religious courts, religious services and councils, their powers and elections (רבנות ראשית, בתי דין רבניים, שירותי דת)
Rights, compensation and legal aid for victims of terror and hostile acts and their families (נפגעי פעולות איבה, נפגעי טרור)

Loyalty to the state: oaths of allegiance, cutting funding to bodies or educators acting against the state or supporting terror, banning enemy or PA flags, flag protection (נאמנות למדינה, הנפת דגל, שלילת תמיכה)
State commissions of inquiry (e.g. into October 7 failures, spyware) and accountability of security chiefs (ועדת חקירה ממלכתית)
Land policy: Israel Land Authority, JNF/KKL, grazing land farms, admission committees and community settlements, cooperative societies (מקרקעי ישראל, קק"ל, שטחי מרעה, יישוב קהילתי)
Support for frontline and border communities after October 7: Gaza envelope, northern confrontation line, Kiryat Shmona, tax benefits and economic aid for the home front (קו העימות, עוטף עזה)
Revoking citizenship or residency of terrorists (ביטול אזרחות או תושבות)
Culture, heritage and commemoration: memorial days, heritage centers for communities and leaders, Yemenite children affair (הנצחה, מורשת, יום זיכרון)
Domestic violence and violence against women: definitions, electronic monitoring, protection orders, victims' rights (אלימות במשפחה)
Students' rights and access to higher education: tuition, admission rules, student insurance fees (זכויות הסטודנט, השכלה גבוהה)
Health services in the periphery: hospitals and emergency rooms in remote towns, reducing the center-periphery health gap (בריאות בפריפריה)
Fighting racism and hate crimes: defining racism, nationalist or gender-based hate offenses, racist incitement (גזענות, פשעי שנאה)
Election procedures and party finance: voting arrangements, local election rules, campaign financing (בחירות, מימון מפלגות)
Fair representation of groups (Arabs, Haredim, Ethiopians and others) in government companies, civil service and planning bodies (ייצוג הולם)
Palestinian Authority payments to terrorists ('pay for slay'), freezing and offsetting PA funds, interim agreement restrictions (הרשות הפלסטינית, כספים בזיקה לטרור)
Environment and climate: climate law, plastic bags, recycling, cleanliness, trees, solar energy (אקלים, סביבה, מיחזור)
Consumer protection: billing, contracts, labeling, flight cancellations, class actions, bank fees (הגנת הצרכן)
Disqualifying candidates or removing MKs and officials who support terror or armed struggle (פסילת מועמדים, הדחת חבר כנסת)
Applying Israeli sovereignty / annexation to Judea and Samaria, the Jordan Valley or specific settlements (החלת ריבונות)
Political control and independence of the police: minister's authority over policy, appointments, opening investigations, protest dispersal, national guard (המשטרה, השר, משמר לאומי)
Debts, debt collection, enforcement office and insolvency (הוצאה לפועל, חדלות פירעון)
Cost of living: food prices, monopolies, competition, price controls (יוקר המחיה, מחירים, מונופול)
LGBT rights: conversion therapy ban, discrimination by sexual orientation or gender identity, adoption (להט"ב, טיפולי המרה)
General income tax, property tax and deductions not tied to a specific group (מס הכנסה, מיסוי מקרקעין, ניכויים)
UNRWA: ending its activity in Israel, revoking its immunities (אונר"א)
Unemployment benefits, including for the self-employed (דמי אבטלה)
Enshrining the right to equality or the Declaration of Independence in Basic Laws (הזכות לשוויון, מגילת העצמאות)
Freedom of speech and press: journalists' protection and privilege, censorship, insulting public servants, denial laws (October 7, Nakba) (חופש הביטוי, עיתונאים)
Workers' rights: minimum wage, sick leave, wage protection, women's employment protections (שכר מינימום, זכויות עובדים)
Term limits for the Prime Minister and barring a PM under indictment (הגבלת כהונת ראש הממשלה)
Religion in public space: public transport and electricity on Shabbat, chametz on Passover in hospitals, Shabbat work (שבת, חמץ, תחבורה ציבורית בשבת)
Senior citizens: old-age allowance, long-term care, protection of elderly (אזרחים ותיקים, קצבת זקנה, סיעוד)
Developing the periphery: Negev and Galilee, new airport, universities, regional authorities (פריפריה, נגב, גליל)
COVID-19 emergency measures and related economic relief (נגיף הקורונה)
Rights of suspects and defendants: interrogation limits, searches, evidence exclusion, bail, torture ban (זכויות חשודים)
School curriculum and content: heritage studies, financial education, smartphones in schools, incitement in curricula (תוכנית לימודים)

Haredi education: core curriculum requirements, state Haredi school stream, funding of Haredi institutions (לימודי ליבה, חינוך חרדי)
State budget laws, deficit reduction and budget amendments (תקציב המדינה)
Prohibiting discrimination in products, services, housing and public places (איסור הפליה)
Model of military service: mandatory service for all, abolishing conscription, women's service, encouraging civil-national service (שירות חובה לכל, גיוס חובה)
Expanding health coverage: national health basket, subsidies for treatments and equipment, patients' rights to timely care (ביטוח בריאות ממלכתי, סל הבריאות)
The Nation-State Basic Law: repealing it or adding equality (חוק הלאום)
Daycare and early childhood: subsidies, regulation, caregivers (מעונות יום, גיל הרך)
Mental health, trauma and addiction services (בריאות הנפש, התמכרויות)
Media and telecom regulation: broadcasting rules, social networks, online content removal (תקשורת, שידורים, רשתות חברתיות)

Police and security powers of search and surveillance: device searches, biometrics, cameras, anonymous SIM cards (חיפוש, האזנה, מאגר ביומטרי)
Cannabis: legalization, decriminalization, medical cannabis (קנאביס)
VAT exemptions or zero rate on essentials such as medicines and textbooks (מע"מ, פטור)
Banning foreign broadcasters harming state security, e.g. Al Jazeera (גוף שידורים זר)
Foreign policy and hostile entities: declaring states or Gaza hostile, the ICC and international institutions (מדינת אויב, בית הדין הבין-לאומי)
Home-front protection: shelters and safe rooms, education during emergencies (מיגון, מקלטים, מרחב מוגן)

Rights and accessibility for people with disabilities (אנשים עם מוגבלות, נגישות)

Animal welfare and wildlife protection (צער בעלי חיים)
Parking fees and toll roads (חניה, כביש אגרה)

Death penalty for terrorists (עונש מוות למחבלים)
Public transport services, fares and ride-sharing (תחבורה ציבורית)
Harsher penalties for sexual and violent crimes, offenses against minors or the vulnerable (עבירות מין, אונס)

Regulating NGOs and funding from foreign governments (עמותות, ישות מדינית זרה)

Firearm licenses for civilians (רישיון כלי ירייה)

Arabic language status and services in Arabic (השפה הערבית)

Tobacco and smoking regulation (טבק, עישון)

Civil marriage and divorce outside the rabbinate (נישואים אזרחיים)
Humanitarian aid to Palestinians from state funds (סיוע הומניטרי)
